systems.country_label: Numéro d'Identification Personnel (NIP); attestation du NIP
systems.platform: 14-character alphanumeric number issued after biometric capture; draws on IBOGA biometric enrolment and the electoral roll since 2013
systems.owner: Ministry of the Interior, Security and Decentralisation; DGDI
systems.tiers: from 3 April 2024 in dedicated centres of Grand Libreville (Libreville, Owendo, Akanda, Ntoum: police stations, DGDI offices, two arrondissement town halls, the prefecture) in a first phase, then the whole territory

systems.owner: Ministry of the Interior, Security and Decentralisation
systems.tiers: preceded by attribution of the NIP

note: Identity-number enrolment only (class identity); a legalised copy of a birth certificate is a supporting document, and the page notes that a birth notice and a supplementary judgment are not civil status acts. Nothing on how offices register.
